races.name: Sedgefield Racecourse Supports Autism In Racing Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Captain Cool
runners_data.note: Only confirmed front-runner with sustainable style but soft ground stamina untested at this trip

runners_data.name: Maple
runners_data.note: Classic hold-up horse whose recent placings suggest readiness for a breakthrough performance

runners_data.name: Belaya River
runners_data.note: Highest-rated hold-up horse with proven soft ground winning form at similar distances

runners_data.name: Diamond Jim
runners_data.note: Highest OR in field but needs to position perfectly behind Captain Cool to maximize class advantage

runners_data.name: Fine Point
runners_data.note: Most consistent recent form but lowest OR suggests he needs everything to fall right

runners_data.name: Blackwater Lilly
runners_data.note: Hold-up style suits but poor recent form suggests she's not firing on all cylinders

runners_data.name: Ambassador
runners_data.note: Prominent style compromised by significantly lower OR and patchy recent efforts

races.paceDynamic: Captain Cool will lead from the front with minimal pressure, as Diamond Jim and Fine Point (the only other forward-going horses) are more prominent than pace-pressing types. This sets up a moderate, sustainable gallop that will favor the strong-finishing hold-up horses like Belaya River and Maple, who can time their challenges late over this stamina-testing trip on testing ground.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Captain Cool gets an easy lead and finds enough stamina reserves for the finish
scenarios.body: The confirmed front-runner builds an unassailable advantage through controlled fractions and has enough left to repel late challenges. His recent Soft going form shows he can handle these conditions when allowed to dictate.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly pedestrian and favors patient tactics
scenarios.body: Belaya River and Maple get the perfect setup to unleash devastating late runs, with Belaya River's superior class (OR 107) and recent Soft ground win giving the edge. The testing conditions will find out Captain Cool's stamina limitations.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Diamond Jim can press Captain Cool just enough to soften him up
scenarios.body: Diamond Jim's higher OR of 110 tells when positioned perfectly behind the leader, timing his challenge at the second-last hurdle. His recent win at Goodwood shows he has the tactical speed to capitalize when the pace quickens.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Captain Cool stops suddenly and the race becomes a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace means multiple horses arrive together at the last hurdle, creating a scramble where Fine Point's recent consistency gives him the edge. This becomes a lottery finish where OR ratings matter less than who stays strongest.

watchPoints.text: Captain Cool must show early fluency over hurdles as any jumping errors will compromise his front-running tactics
Diamond Jim's positioning in first half-mile is crucial - too close pressures Captain Cool, too far back negates his class edge
Belaya River needs the pace to be honest enough to set up her late run but not so strong it becomes a stamina test
Fine Point requires the race to develop into a sprint finish to overcome his significant OR disadvantage
Watch for any market moves on Maple as connections may know she's ready to show her true ability

races.name: Sign Lead Your Horse To Water Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Mountain Mike
runners_data.note: Highest-rated runner who should appreciate the prominent position behind two confirmed leaders

runners_data.name: Realisation
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist needs others to go hard early to set up his customary late rally

runners_data.name: Stratagem
runners_data.note: Most consistent performer on soft ground recently but needs tactical race to offset class deficit

runners_data.name: Mary Stanford
runners_data.note: Natural front runner who may benefit if Ailt An Chorrain takes her on too aggressively early

runners_data.name: Ailt An Chorrain
runners_data.note: Another confirmed leader whose recent soft ground form shows three places from seven attempts

races.paceDynamic: Ailt An Chorrain and Mary Stanford will dispute the early lead, with both habitual front runners likely to set honest fractions from the start. Mountain Mike and Stratagem should track prominently behind the leaders, while Realisation settles last as usual, relying on his trademark late charge to get competitive.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Gallop Suits
scenarios.trigger: If the two leaders maintain a strong gallop throughout without killing each other off
scenarios.body: Mountain Mike can capitalize from his prominent position when the front pair weaken, having the class edge over Stratagem. Realisation may find the sustained pace stretches his finishing kick too thin.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runners Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Ailt An Chorrain and Mary Stanford go too hard early and both fade dramatically
scenarios.body: Realisation gets the perfect setup for his hold-up style, sweeping past tired leaders in the closing stages. Mountain Mike benefits but may lack Realisation's finishing power.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Battle Develops
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes stop-start with neither leader committing fully
scenarios.body: Mary Stanford can use her race fitness edge to outstay rivals in a sprint finish, while Ailt An Chorrain benefits from the easier tempo. The prominent runners get caught in no-man's land.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Moderate Pace Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders settle into a comfortable rhythm without serious pressure
scenarios.body: Stratagem's recent consistency on similar ground allows him to stay with the pace and grind out a surprise victory. Mountain Mike's class tells but he may not get the strong gallop he needs.

watchPoints.text: Watch if both Mary Stanford and Ailt An Chorrain refuse to give way early, creating unsustainable fractions
Monitor Mountain Mike's jumping rhythm as he may need to travel keenly to stay in touch with the leaders
Observe Realisation's position turning for home as his late kick relies entirely on others setting strong pace
Check if Stratagem can maintain his prominent position when the tempo inevitably increases after the second last
Watch for any early mistakes from the leaders as this small field offers limited recovery options

races.name: Jayne And Greg Complete All The Racecourses Handicap Chase

runners_data.name: Clean Getaway
runners_data.note: Prominent racer who handles soft going adequately but lacks a recent win to inspire confidence

runners_data.name: Dixie Cowboy
runners_data.note: Uncontested leader with excellent soft ground form and tactical advantage but stamina questions at this trip

runners_data.name: Nonbinding
runners_data.note: Consistent prominent performer with solid soft ground record who could benefit from tracking the leader

runners_data.name: Restandbethankful
runners_data.note: Prominent style but poor soft going record raises serious doubts about effectiveness today

runners_data.name: Beep Beep Becky
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist with good recent third but untested over this specific trip combination

runners_data.name: Natural Ability
runners_data.note: Patient type with decent soft form but hasn't won in 15 attempts despite regular placings

runners_data.name: Myfavouritesister
runners_data.note: Lowest rated but recent third suggests some form, though completely unproven on soft going

runners_data.name: Elusive Warrior
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who handles soft conditions but lacks any recent winning form to build confidence

races.paceDynamic: Dixie Cowboy will dictate a steady, sustainable gallop as the sole confirmed front-runner, with Clean Getaway, Nonbinding and Restandbethankful settling prominently behind. The four hold-up horses create a significant back division that will need the pace to collapse or strong staying power to make their challenge count over this trip.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Dixie Cowboy Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Dixie Cowboy gets an uncontested lead and maintains stamina
scenarios.body: The front-runner controls throughout while prominent runners fail to quicken sufficiently. His strong soft ground record (1W 4P from 12) and tactical advantage prove decisive.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Battle Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent trio engage Dixie Cowboy from halfway and sustain pressure
scenarios.body: Clean Getaway or Nonbinding wear down the leader through sustained pressure up the straight. The hold-up horses arrive too late having given the leaders too much rope.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Swoops
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes unsustainably strong or the prominent horses tie up
scenarios.body: Natural Ability or Beep Beep Becky benefit from a collapse ahead to deliver their trademark late challenge. The early leaders pay for their exertions as fresher horses arrive with winning runs.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Emerges Late
scenarios.trigger: If the race fragments completely with pace collapse and traffic problems
scenarios.body: Myfavouritesister or Elusive Warrior capitalize on chaos ahead, finding gaps when others are stopped. Multiple fallers or mistakes create opportunities for patient outsiders with decent recent form.

watchPoints.text: Dixie Cowboy could steal this if allowed uncontested fractions and maintains stamina over the extended trip
Clean Getaway and Nonbinding must position aggressively early to avoid giving Dixie Cowboy too much rope
Natural Ability needs a strong pace collapse to deliver his hold-up style effectively from the back
Restandbethankful's poor soft ground record makes backing risky despite consistent prominent racing style
Multiple hold-up horses could create traffic problems in the straight if they all arrive together

races.name: Fairlight Studios Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Phantom Gold
runners_data.note: Uncontested front runner whose sustainable pace style perfectly suits having five hold-up horses behind him

runners_data.name: Monark Wood
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with modest rating who needs others to go too fast early to have any chance

runners_data.name: Bright Legend
runners_data.note: Only prominent runner who could track Phantom Gold closer than the pure hold-up horses

runners_data.name: Fearless Dragon
runners_data.note: Hold-up style with decent soft ground record but modest rating limits winning chances

runners_data.name: Hay Max
runners_data.note: Joint top-rated hold-up horse whose class could tell if he gets the right tactical scenario

runners_data.name: Who's Glen
runners_data.note: Best soft ground record of the hold-up horses with good recent form in similar conditions

races.paceDynamic: Phantom Gold will lead uncontested with five hold-up horses behind him, creating a slow, tactical affair early. The large contingent of hold-up runners (Monark Wood, Fearless Dragon, Hay Max, Who's Glen) will bunch up behind the leader with only Bright Legend likely to track closer, setting up a sprint finish where positioning and timing will be crucial.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Phantom Gold Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Phantom Gold sets sensible fractions and isn't pressured early
scenarios.body: The leader builds a soft lead before quickening approaching the last, holding off late challengers who leave their runs too late. His uncontested lead and proven front-running style proves decisive in this tactical contest.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Charge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too slow and bunched turning for home
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get perfectly positioned in the pack before unleashing late runs, with superior acceleration overwhelming the tiring leader. Who's Glen's soft ground form and tactical speed proves ideal for this scenario.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Bright Legend Tracks Smart
scenarios.trigger: If Bright Legend positions closer to the pace than the other hold-up horses
scenarios.body: The prominent runner shadows Phantom Gold before taking over after the last hurdle, benefiting from a perfect stalking position while others are trapped behind. His superior rating and tactical advantage from tracking the pace proves decisive.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Phantom Gold goes too slow early allowing all rivals perfect positioning
scenarios.body: The race becomes a cavalry charge from the last hurdle with the highest-rated horses prevailing in a blanket finish. Hay Max's class tells in a messy sprint finish where pure ability matters most.

watchPoints.text: Phantom Gold building too big a lead early - if uncontested he could be gone before others react
Who's Glen getting a clean run from the back - his soft ground form makes him dangerous if positioned well
Bright Legend's positioning turning in - if he's closer than the other hold-up horses he has a major advantage
How bunched the hold-up horses become mid-race - too tight and they'll struggle for racing room
The pace after the second last hurdle - this race will be won or lost on who quickens best from there

races.name: MW Civils & Groundworks Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Byron Hill
runners_data.note: Consistent prominent runner who handles soft ground well and stays this trip strongly

runners_data.name: Achnamara
runners_data.note: Natural front runner but recent form suggests vulnerability when pressed for pace

runners_data.name: Kopa Kilana
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse needing significant pace collapse to be competitive from current ratings

runners_data.name: Top Flight Century
runners_data.note: Recent winner who excels when getting patient ride from off the pace

runners_data.name: Cosmic Soul
runners_data.note: In excellent current form with three straight wins, thrives racing prominently

runners_data.name: Knacker Trapper
runners_data.note: Solid each-way type who needs everything to fall right from rear of field

runners_data.name: Laddie Cooper Mia
runners_data.note: Proven in testing ground conditions but needs career-best effort to win

runners_data.name: Mr Globalist
runners_data.note: Consistent prominent runner but lacks recent winning form to be confident

runners_data.name: Seeyainthesuninn
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse whose soft ground record is patchy across limited attempts

runners_data.name: Deauville Lady
runners_data.note: Proven soft ground performer but needs significant improvement on recent efforts

races.paceDynamic: Achnamara will likely lead with Byron Hill and Cosmic Soul pressing close behind, creating a steady but not overly strong gallop in the soft conditions. With several hold-up horses including Top Flight Century, Kopa Kilana, and Swingforthefence needing to be produced late, the pace should be sustainable allowing closers to get competitive.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Gallop Suits Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If Achnamara, Byron Hill and Cosmic Soul maintain strong pace without folding
scenarios.body: The prominent runners get first run on the field and soft ground prevents late closers from making significant inroads. Byron Hill's consistency at this trip and Cosmic Soul's current winning form tell.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge from Closers
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes moderate allowing hold-up horses time and room
scenarios.body: Top Flight Century and Kopa Kilana get the patient ride they need and produce late kicks when leaders tire. The soft ground aids their stamina reserves over this staying trip.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Speed Battle
scenarios.trigger: If Byron Hill and Cosmic Soul engage Achnamara in prolonged pace pressure
scenarios.body: The three prominent runners go too fast too early, setting up the race for mid-division horses with more tactical speed. Swingforthefences and Seeyainthesuninn benefit from the collapse ahead.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Soft Ground Specialist
scenarios.trigger: If conditions deteriorate further during racing favoring proven heavy ground performers
scenarios.body: Laddie Cooper Mia's recent heavy ground run and Deauville Lady's soft ground experience become crucial factors. The testing surface finds out those uncomfortable with the underfoot conditions.

watchPoints.text: Achnamara could fold quickly if Byron Hill and Cosmic Soul apply sustained pressure from the outset
Top Flight Century needs clear running room in straight as hold-up horses often get boxed in here
Cosmic Soul's jumping under pressure will be crucial given three-race winning sequence
Weather deterioration during racing would significantly favor Laddie Cooper Mia's chances
Swingforthefences needs patient ride but jockey may panic if pace becomes pedestrian early
